definitions.gloss: leaving a group; departing from a troupe or team
definitions.explanation: The act of leaving an organized group such as a sports team, theater troupe, musical group, or similar organization.

examples.japanese: {今季|こんき}⟦{限|かぎ}り→限り：00133_kagiri⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{退団|たいだん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He will leave the team at the end of this season.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{退団|たいだん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ファン→ファン：10065_fan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{衝撃|しょうげき}→衝撃：08678_shougeki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えた→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
examples.english: The popular player's departure shocked the fans.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{十年間|じゅうねんかん}⟦{在籍|ざいせき}→在籍：21436_zaiseki⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{劇団|げきだん}→劇団：20045_gekidan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{退団|たいだん}し、⟦{独立|どくりつ}→独立：03488_dokuritsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: She left the theater troupe she had belonged to for ten years and went independent.

notes:
Most commonly used in the context of sports teams and theater troupes (especially {宝塚歌劇団|たからづかかげきだん}). The ⟦{団|だん}→〜団：04663_dan⟧ refers to an organized group or troupe.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {退団|たいだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}する→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧ — to announce one's departure
- {退団|たいだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決意|けつい}する→決意する：28116_ketsuisuru⟧ — to decide to leave the group
- ⟦{円満|えんまん}→円満：17922_enman⟧{退団|たいだん} — amicable departure
- {今季|こんき}⟦{限|かぎ}り→限り：00133_kagiri⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{退団|たいだん} — leaving at the end of this season

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{脱退|だったい}→脱退：05770_dattai⟧ — withdrawal, secession (from a larger organization, treaty, or union; stronger nuance)
- ⟦{退会|たいかい}→退会：16082_taikai⟧ — withdrawal from a club or association
- ⟦{退社|たいしゃ}→退社：06156_taisha⟧ — leaving a company
- ⟦{入団|にゅうだん}→入団：11972_nyuudan⟧ — joining a group (the opposite)
